hero.purpose: Reserved oversized display step (--fs-xxl) for viewport-dominating titles. Defined in tokens; default h1 currently ships at Display.

display.purpose: Page h1 and hero titles. Barlow Condensed, uppercase, tracked.

headline.purpose: Section titles with the red accent underline.

label.purpose: Buttons, subtitles, nav links, chips — uppercase condensed.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Default resting elevation for cards and icon tiles.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Navy-tinted lift on card hover, paired with translateY(-6px).

shadows.name: card-hover-strong
shadows.purpose: Deeper lift for icon tiles that invert to navy on hover.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Red-tinted glow under a lifted primary button.

shadows.name: nav
shadows.purpose: Faint drop under the floating glass navigation bar.

motion.name: ease-smooth
motion.purpose: Default ease-out curve for every state transition and reveal.

motion.name: ease-pop
motion.purpose: Sparse momentary confirmation accents (hover-in snaps, active-state pops) — never hover-loops, idle loops, or entrance cascades.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Hero/entrance cascades and disclosure panels (nav menus, accordions).

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #BD3A4E, #C94E60); color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A83245, #B8444F); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(189,58,78,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(189,58,78,0.2); } .ds-btn-chevron { transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-chevron { transform: translateX(2px); }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 32px; border: 1px solid #BD3A4E; border-radius: 0; color: #BD3A4E; background: linear-gradient(to right, #BD3A4E 50%, transparent 50%); background-size: 200% 100%; background-position: right; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-position 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-position: left; color: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(189,58,78,0.3); }

components.name: Section Title
components.description: Eyebrow subtitle with a red dash, over a navy uppercase headline carrying a red accent underline.
components.css: .ds-section-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 12px; color: #273E79; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 28px; height: 2px; background: #BD3A4E; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-headline { position: relative; display: inline-block; margin: 0; color: #273E79; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 2.5rem); font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-headline::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 0; width: 40px; height: 3px; background: #BD3A4E; border-radius: 2px; transition: width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-headline:hover::after { width: 80px; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 320px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(39,62,121,0.06); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 5px 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.35s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(39,62,121,0.12), 0 8px 16px rgba(39,62,121,0.08); border-color: rgba(39,62,121,0.12); } .ds-card-media { height: 200px; width: 100%; } .ds-card-body { padding: 28px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; color: #273E79; text-align: center; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1.4rem; } .ds-card-sub { margin: 4px 0 0; text-align: center; color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-text { margin: 16px 0 0; color: #4B5563; font-family: 'DM Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 300; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.7; text-align: justify; }

components.name: Icon Tile
components.description: Selectable tile that inverts to full navy on hover/select and reveals a red bottom bar.
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; width: 200px; padding: 40px 8px; display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #273E79; border: none; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 5px 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.35s ease, color 0.35s ease; } .ds-tile::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 3px; background: #BD3A4E; transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tile:hover { background: #273E79; color: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(39,62,121,0.18); } .ds-tile:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-tile-icon { transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-icon { transform: scale(1.15); } .ds-tile-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; font-size: 1rem; }

narrative.overview: The system wears the club's colours the way a team wears its strip: deep royal navy is the jersey, crimson red is the trim, and there is no apology in either. This is an athletic identity, not a corporate one. Condensed uppercase type reads like a scoreboard and a matchday programme; angular clip-path dividers cut across the layout with the diagonal energy of a body in motion; the accent red is rationed like a captain's armband so it always means something. The palette is Committed — navy carries whole dark sections end to end, red owns the interactive layer, and a single coastal cyan exists purely to keep accents legible on navy. Photography does the heavy lifting for warmth and place; the chrome around it stays disciplined. This system explicitly rejects the beige-editorial landing page, the pastel wellness-app look, and the flat startup-blue template.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-and-red team-colours identity, committed and unhedged.
Condensed, uppercase, tracked display type (scoreboard energy).
Angular clip-path section dividers as a signature motif.
Red used sparingly as the interactive/accent voice.
Soft ambient shadows and a consistent lift-on-hover language.

rules.name: The Armband Rule
rules.body: Club Red is reserved for the interactive and emphasis layer — buttons, link underlines, accent bars — and should sit on roughly ≤10% of any screen. Its scarcity is what makes it read as important. Never wallpaper a section in red.

rules.name: The Cyan-On-Navy Rule
rules.body: Inside any full-navy (section-dark) block, accents switch from red to Coastal Cyan. Red on navy muddies; cyan cuts. This swap is automatic, not optional.

rules.name: The Condensed-Caps Rule
rules.body: Every heading, button, nav link, and label is Barlow Condensed in UPPERCASE with open tracking. This is the club's voice; do not set headings in DM Sans or in sentence case.

rules.name: The Quiet-Body Rule
rules.body: Body copy is DM Sans at weight 300 with roomy line-height. Never bold body paragraphs for emphasis and never set body copy in uppercase — emphasis is the display font's job.

rules.name: The Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive surfaces are flat-ish at rest and rise toward the user on hover (translateY(-6px) for cards, -2px for buttons) with a deeper, colour-tinted shadow. Shadows are a response to state, not decoration applied at rest.

rules.name: The Navy-Tint Rule
rules.body: Card shadows tint toward navy (rgba(39,62,121,...)) and button shadows toward red (rgba(189,58,78,...)). Pure-black shadows are only used at the faintest ambient level; coloured shadows are what make the depth feel on-brand.

dos: Do set every heading, button, nav link, and label in Barlow Condensed, UPPERCASE, with open tracking (the Condensed-Caps Rule).
Do keep Club Red on ≤10% of a screen, reserved for the interactive/emphasis layer (the Armband Rule).
Do switch accents from red to Coastal Cyan inside full-navy sections (the Cyan-On-Navy Rule).
Do lift interactive surfaces toward the user on hover with a colour-tinted shadow (translateY(-6px) cards, -2px buttons).
Do use the ease-smooth curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for state transitions, at 0.25s/0.35s.
Do lean on real photography for warmth and place; keep the surrounding chrome disciplined.
Do use the angular clip-path dividers as the signature transition between sections.
Do provide the prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every reveal and entrance animation.
donts: Don't set headings or buttons in DM Sans or in sentence case — the display voice is condensed caps only.
Don't bold body copy or set body copy in uppercase for emphasis; emphasis is the display font's job.
Don't wallpaper sections in Club Red or let it drift past its ~10% budget.
Don't put Club Red accents on navy grounds (muddy); use Coastal Cyan instead.
Don't round the buttons — they are deliberately square against the rounded card language.
Don't use pure-black heavy shadows at rest; depth is soft, ambient, and colour-tinted.
Don't spread the navbar's glassmorphism to other surfaces — the translucent blur is the navigation's alone, not a decorative default.
Don't collapse this into a generic startup-blue or beige-editorial template; it is a proud local club, not a SaaS landing page.
